related_questions.question: Should I get a fourth COVID jab?
related_questions.snippet: Some people need an extra dose of the COVID-19 vaccine if they have a health condition or treatment that severely weakens their immune system. For example, if they have had a stem cell transplant or CAR-T therapy. Your GP or specialist will assess your risk and tell you if you need an extra dose of the vaccine.

The FDA's Vaccines and Related Biological Products Advisory Committee (VRBPAC) has recommended a monovalent JN.1-lineage vaccine for this season. The CDC also recommends a 2024-2025 COVID-19 vaccine for most adults 18 and older.
